study: Preschool Curriculum Evaluation Research (PCER) Consortium 2008 (NCER 2008-2009), 14 preschool curricula RCTs
delivery_evidence: Across teams, teacher training in the treatment curriculum was face-to-face: pre-school-year workshops (e.g., 3-day workshops, two 1-day workshops) plus ongoing in-person support (onsite consultations, mentoring/coaching visits) ('Teacher training' and 'Ongoing support' sections; amount varied by team but all in-person/onsite); no online PD reported.
test_alignment_evidence: Included child-achievement outcomes are predominantly broad standardized independent tests (TERA, WJ Letter-Word/Spelling/Applied Problems, PPVT, TOLD, Pre-CTOPPP, CMA-A) plus the researcher-made Shape Composition (Building Blocks) task (Table E; per-effect test_type), so the set spans both.
curriculum_evidence: The entire study evaluates adoption of specific new preschool curricula (e.g., Creative Curriculum, DLM+Open Court, Pre-K Mathematics, Doors to Discovery) against business-as-usual; the PD is the training/support to implement each adopted curriculum (study design; 'teacher training in the use of a treatment curriculum').
outcome_timing_evidence: Extracted effect sizes are at spring of pre-kindergarten, the end of the one-year curriculum implementation (immediate post; Table E). The end-of-kindergarten follow-up wave (Table F) was not extracted.
